question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Denote
solution:
The correct answer is: **Conceal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Denote"** means to be a sign of; to indicate or represent something. (सूचित करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The red color on the map denotes danger zones.
 
 
 
• **"Conceal"** means to hide or keep something secret; to prevent something from being known or seen. (छुपाना)
 
 
• **Example:** She tried to conceal her disappointment when she didn't get the job.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'denote'** is **'conceal'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Conceal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Convey** (व्यक्त करना): To communicate or express something.
 
 
• **Example:** He tried to convey his feelings through a heartfelt letter.
 
 
 
• **Conclude** (निष्कर्ष निकालना): To bring something to an end or to reach a decision.
 
 
• **Example:** The meeting concluded with a vote of thanks.
 
 
 
• **Convince** (मनाना): To persuade someone to do something or to believe that something is true.
 
 
• **Example:** She managed to convince him to join the team.
